title: Passage-Aware Structural Mapping for RGB-D Visual SLAM
summary: A structural RGB-D mapping approach that combines geometric, semantic, topological, and traversal-history evidence to represent passages.

mechanisms.name: Passage-evidence structural map
mechanisms.description: Models a passage as an opening supported by geometry, semantics, topology, and traversal evidence instead of equating a door-like rectangle with traversability.
mechanisms.limitations: Qualitative mapping evidence does not establish door-state recognition, collision-free traversal, dynamic-obstacle handling, or assistive-user outcomes.
